module_summary: DarkRISCV bus-mapped UART: independent TX and RX state machines with baud down-counters move bytes between single-byte buffers and serial lines, using toggle req/ack flags and a state-change IRQ.

anchors.name: UART_XSTATE
anchors.why: TX sequencer idle/start/data bits/stop/ack; low bits index transmitted bit.

anchors.name: UART_RSTATE
anchors.why: RX sequencer with start detection; indexes received bit position.

anchors.name: TXD
anchors.why: Serial transmit line driven by TX state and buffered byte bit.

anchors.name: RXD
anchors.why: Serial receive line shifted into the RXD synchronizer.

anchors.name: DATAO
anchors.why: Bus read data: baud timer, received byte and UART status.

anchors.name: DATAI
anchors.why: Bus write data; byte 1 loaded into TX buffer.

anchors.name: UART_XFIFO
anchors.why: TX byte buffer held while the TX FSM shifts its bits out.

anchors.name: UART_RFIFO
anchors.why: RX byte buffer assembled bit by bit, read through DATAO.

anchors.name: UART_XBAUD
anchors.why: TX baud down-counter advancing UART_XSTATE at zero.

anchors.name: UART_RBAUD
anchors.why: RX baud down-counter, half-period preload for mid-bit sampling.

anchors.name: UART_XREQ
anchors.why: Toggle request from bus write; XREQ!=XACK starts transmission.

anchors.name: UART_RREQ
anchors.why: Toggle flag marking received byte available to the bus.

anchors.name: UART_XACK
anchors.why: TX ack toggled at end of frame to complete transmit request.

anchors.name: UART_RACK
anchors.why: RX ack updated on bus read of byte 1, consuming received byte.

anchors.name: UART_STATE
anchors.why: Status byte: RX data available and TX busy flags.

anchors.name: UART_STATEFF
anchors.why: Snapshot of status on read; differences raise IRQ.

anchors.name: IRQ
anchors.why: Interrupt when status differs from last acknowledged snapshot.

anchors.name: UART_RXDFF
anchors.why: 3-stage RXD synchronizer used for start-edge detect and sampling.

anchors.name: UART_TIMER
anchors.why: Constant baud divisor reloading both baud counters.

anchors.name: WR
anchors.why: Bus write loading TX buffer and LASTCHAR.

anchors.name: RD
anchors.why: Bus read acknowledging RX byte and status.

anchors.name: BE
anchors.why: Byte enables selecting TX data byte or status ack.

anchors.name: LASTCHAR
anchors.why: Last written character, unused debug copy.

anchors.name: DEBUG
anchors.why: Debug view of RXD, TXD and TX/RX busy.

groups.name: Bus interface
groups.description: Register read/write decode, status snapshot and IRQ generation.

groups.name: TX engine
groups.description: TX FSM serializes buffered byte with start and stop bits.

groups.name: RX engine
groups.description: RX FSM detects start edge and deserializes bits into buffer.

groups.name: Baud timers
groups.description: TX/RX baud down-counters reloaded from constant timer.
